strategy.title: Deliver the three signed propane-dealer leak-check batches through Keystone
strategy.why: Three dealers signed written work orders at $2,700 a batch ($8,100). Keystone's quote is $1,425 a batch ($4,275), paid out of each dealer's payment, so no capital is advanced. reviews.reasons: EXECUTABLE is right. Every link of the one member (cop_29ad...) rests on its own record: three WRITTEN_ACCEPTANCE agreements at $2,700 each (a real purchase price from the paying buyers themselves), a supplier quote of $95/tank = $1,425/batch from the recorded fulfiller Keystone, payment 10 days after each batch and Keystone paid from each receipt within 2 days. Recomputed: 3 x $2,700 = $8,100; 3 x $1,425 = $4,275; net $3,825 >= $3,500 target. Capacity 10 tanks/day from day 2 covers 45 tanks by day 6 (batches complete days 3, 4, 6 as stated); receipts days 13/14/16, last supplier payment day 18, all inside 30 days. Ledger trace: owner funded $0, minimum cash $2,700 (never negative), exposure $0 against a $0 cap. Excluded cylinder restock correctly rejected: $23 cost > $22 price.
findings: Arithmetic checked: $8,100 collected - $4,275 Keystone = $3,825 net, $325 above target; ledger matches steps.
Schedule checked: 45 tanks at 10/day from day 2 completes day 6; dealer payments days 13, 14, 16; Keystone paid days 15, 16, 18; all within 30 days with 12 days slack.
No capital: Keystone is paid out of each dealer receipt, so cash never goes below $0 (trace minCash $2,700, ownerFunded $0).
Thin margin: target is met only if all three dealers pay in full; a single default or a dispute misses it. Plan should watch collections closely.
Execution capabilities (SEND_A_MESSAGE, ISSUE_AN_INVOICE, PAY_A_SUPPLIER) are NOT_CONNECTED/NOT_DECLARED; these must be connected before steps run, but they are operational, not evidence gaps.
members[].ownerHours is null though the card records humanHours 1; contract states no hours ceiling so it fits, but should carry the 1 hour.
Brain's own check lists the deliver step owner as PERSON while the card and plan name Keystone as fulfiller; the plan's performer (Keystone) matches the record.
